object_types.name: Client
object_types.description: Customer organization receiving an FDE solution

object_types.name: Project
object_types.description: Forward deployed engineering delivery engagement with delivery status, progress and go-live date

object_types.name: Employee
object_types.description: Delivery team member assigned to projects and possessing technical or domain skills

object_types.name: Skill
object_types.description: Technical or domain capability possessed by an employee or required by a project

object_types.name: Risk
object_types.description: Delivery risk or blocker that may affect a project or milestone

object_types.name: Milestone
object_types.description: Delivery checkpoint such as UAT completion or production go-live

relationships.meaning: project is delivered for a client
employee is assigned to a project
project requires a skill for successful delivery
project has an identified delivery risk
risk blocks or threatens a milestone
employee owns mitigation of a risk

hierarchy.meaning: a critical risk is a specialized high-severity risk
production go-live is a specialized delivery milestone

semantic_rules.name: SkillGap
semantic_rules.description: A project has a skill gap when it REQUIRES a Skill and no Employee who WORKS_ON that Project HAS_SKILL that Skill

semantic_rules.name: GoLiveThreat
semantic_rules.description: An open CRITICAL Risk is a go-live threat when it BLOCKS a Milestone whose type is GO_LIVE
